feedback: Do not make the applicability conditions universal requirements on every targeted ship. Encode the PC6-or-PC7 and vertical-sided-bow conditions as the applicability guard for the design-ice-force method/check, so ships outside that scope are not rejected. Also remove sh:minCount 1 from normalFrameAngle unless independent evidence requires an angle value to exist: the requirement constrains every represented considered-sub-region angle to 0–10 degrees inclusive, but does not itself require such a value. Preserve the supplied canonical terms and owner ship; no vocabulary matcher is needed.

current_feedback: Preserve the prior instructions: encode PC6-or-PC7 together with verticalSidedBowForm=true as the applicability guard for the design-ice-force check, rather than using three independent sh:or alternatives. The current graph permits a PC6/PC7 ship with verticalSidedBowForm=false to pass and permits an applicable ship to pass through an unrelated branch; it also makes the method, status, and angle constraints conjunctively mandatory only in one branch. Replace this with an implication-style guard whose applicable branch enforces the required design-force check and the universal 0–10 degree constraint over represented normalFrameAngle values, while the non-applicable branch is satisfied only when the PC6/PC7-plus-vertical-sided-bow conjunction is false. Do not add minCount to normalFrameAngle. Connect bowDesignForceMethod and bowVerticalSideStatus meaningfully to the guarded check or remove them if they are not independently required; mere presence of a string or duplicate boolean is not sufficient. Retain the corrected explicit DEG unit IRI. No vocabulary matcher is needed.

current_feedback: Preserve all prior instructions: replace the three-way sh:or with an implication-style applicability guard. The guard must require explicit polarClass evidence of PC6 or PC7 together with verticalSidedBowForm=true; its non-applicable branch must be satisfied only when that conjunction is false and must not let missing branch-selection evidence pass. The applicable branch must enforce bowDesignForceMethod referencing I2.3.2.1 (iv) and the universal inclusive 0–10 constraint with the explicit http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/DEG unit, without adding minCount to normalFrameAngle. The current PC1–PC5 and verticalSidedBowForm=false alternatives are accidental pass branches. Because the COMPLETE dependency contract declares bowVerticalSideStatus as a direct constraint, encode that obligation meaningfully on the supplied ship owner (without merely duplicating the same fact), or correct the contract before generation; do not omit it. All other supplied canonical terms, owners, datatypes, and units are acceptable, so no vocabulary matcher is needed.
